subject: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The events of the escape from the tower occur on the 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: ## 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: guard chamber
fact: The guard chamber contains a zurkhwood table, three chairs, a side table, and a Sava game set on the table.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and a Sava game set on the table

subject: Derendil
fact: Derendil is a dead prince whose corpse stands as a silent monument in the chamber.
source_quote: The large corpse of the deluded Prince Derendil stands as a silent monument to the price of the victory.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir scours the bodies of dead drow for weapons.
source_quote: Zalthir shows no sentimentality and quickly scours the bodies for any weapons.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith arms himself with studded leather armor, picks up a shield, and places a hand crossbow in a strap on the armor.
source_quote: Sarith arms himself with studded leather armor, picks up a shield, and places one of the hand crossbows in a strap on the armor.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith looks every part of the warrior caste of the Cult of Lolth after equipping Drow weapons.
source_quote: Equipped with the Drow weapons, he looks every part of the warrior caste of the Cult of Lolth.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum finds poisoned hand crossbow bolts and a vial of Drow poison.
source_quote: Grygum finds some poisoned hand crossbow bolts and a vial of what Sarith explains is Drow poison.

subject: poisoned hand crossbow bolts
fact: Grygum hooks poisoned hand crossbow bolts into a loop on his armor.
source_quote: He hooks them into a loop on his armor.

subject: vial of Drow poison
fact: Grygum hooks a vial of Drow poison into a loop on his armor.
source_quote: He hooks them into a loop on his armor.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters that he will not be wearing armor.
source_quote: Daz stares mournfully at the armor and mutters, “I will not be wearing armor.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin opens the door to the guard room and examines the area past the rope bridge where Ilvara’s residence is.
source_quote: Thorin opens the door to the guard room, peaks outside, examines the area past the rope bridge where Ilvara’s residence is, and mutters, “We need to get our stuff.”

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara’s residence is located past the rope bridge.
source_quote: examines the area past the rope bridge where Ilvara’s residence is

subject: Topsy and Turvy
fact: Topsy and Turvy offer to retrieve the prisoners' stuff for a price.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy look around and shout, “We could get your stuff  for you for a price.”

subject: Topsy and Turvy
fact: Topsy and Turvy transform into rats.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy sigh and then transform into rats.

subject: silk ropes
fact: Zalthir grabs some silk ropes on the pegs to drop down into the web below.
source_quote: Zalthir grabs some silk ropes on the pegs and prepares to drop down into the spidery web below.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido points out that there are very large spiders.
source_quote: Buppido clicks his tongue and points out that there are spiders—very large spiders.

subject: burning the tower
fact: Buppido suggests burning the place down before fleeing.
source_quote: So do we run, or do we first burn the place down?

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith mutters that Ilvara will be honor bound to pursue them.
source_quote: Ilvara will be honor bound to pursue us.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith cackles that revenge is so tasty.
source_quote: revenge is so tasty.

subject: chasme
fact: Four chasme are present in the cavern, fixated on other creatures.
source_quote: He can see these massive and terrible things... four black, bloated flies... Demons: four chasme and two vrock.

subject: vrock
fact: Two vrock are present in the cavern, fighting among demons and Drow.
source_quote: Demons: four chasme and two vrock.

subject: gray ooze
fact: A gray ooze strikes Thorin with a crushing pseudopod.
source_quote: And strikes it does, landing a pseudopod with a crushing blow on Thorin.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is a city full of Drow Cultists located to the north.
source_quote: To the north is Menzoberranzan, a city full of Drow Cultists.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is a location to the south requiring passage through the battle between Drow and Demons.
source_quote: Going south to Blingdenstone would require going through the pitched battle between Drow and Demons.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals connecting water-filled caverns and chambers.
source_quote: The Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals that connect innumerable water-filled caverns and chambers.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake stretches over a hundred miles across with ceilings miles high in some places.
source_quote: This vast waterway stretches over a hundred miles across, with ceilings that are miles high in some places

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake has depths that are unfathomable.
source_quote: and depths that are unfathomable.

subject: duergar engineers
fact: Duergar engineers extended and widened many interconnecting passages of the Darklake.
source_quote: Long ago, duergar engineers extended and widened many of the interconnecting passages of the Darklake.

subject: duergar engineers
fact: Duergar engineers constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft within the Darklake.
source_quote: They also constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft to different levels within it

subject: kuo-toa
fact: Kuo-toa are experienced in navigating the Darklake.
source_quote: Many Underdark creatures are experienced in navigating the Darklake, including the kuo-toa.

subject: Sloopdopblop
fact: Sloopdopblop is a town eight days away from the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Ront
fact: Ront kills himself by attacking a vrock and is killed by it.
source_quote: His first blow cuts through the creature's hide... the demon, with startling speed, kills him with one taloned hand, then grabs the lifeless body with the other while it’s beak envelops the head and snaps it off.

subject: vrock
fact: A vrock lands on the cavern floor with abnormally long, raptor-like clawed arms.
source_quote: an injured vrock lands on the ground... its abnormally long arms, dense with lean muscle, that end in raptor-like claws, scraping the ground.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar proposes a wager about how many prisoners will die before escaping.
source_quote: Anyone wants to make a bet about how many of us will die before any of us escape?

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido claims the divine plan says he will make it to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The divine plan says I will make it Gracklstugh.

subject: wager
fact: Buppido makes a wager with Jimjar about reaching Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Put your money where your mouth is? ... Yes. And a wager is made.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith claims he was a member of the warrior caste and has explored the area thoroughly before imprisonment.
source_quote: Before I was unfairly and unjustly imprisoned, I was a member of the warrior caste, and I have explored this area quite thoroughly.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is the intended destination reachable via the Darklake.
source_quote: If our destination is Gracklstugh, the fastest way to get there is to go through the Darklake.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a myconid who was a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve.
source_quote: Stool, whom they had met as a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is curled against Grygum after waking up.
source_quote: Stool, whom they had met as a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve, was curled against him.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool cries when Grygum tries to push him away.
source_quote: when the orc tried to push him away, the myconid cried.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool says he knows Grygum will bring him home.
source_quote: he knew Grygum would bring him home.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool says he wants to be Grygum’s best friend.
source_quote: He knew he wanted to be Grygum’s best friend.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum takes Stool’s hand and agrees to be friends.
source_quote: When stool extended his hand, Grygum took it.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar points out a fungus that looks like a giant’s tongue.
source_quote: Well, look at this,” shouts Jimjar. ... Thorin thinks it looks like a giant’s tongue.

subject: Tongue of Madness mushroom
fact: The fungus known as the Tongue of Madness is eaten by Thorin and others.
source_quote: It is said that when you eat this mushroom, you connect with the gods.

subject: Tongue of Madness mushroom
fact: The Tongue of Madness mushroom compels its eater to speak the truth.
source_quote: *The Tongue of Madness* will compel its eater to say the truth.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin eats the Tongue of Madness mushroom.
source_quote: Thorin is dubious but chooses to eat the mushroom.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says the Tongue of Madness mushroom connects the eater with the gods.
source_quote: It is said that when you eat this mushroom, you connect with the gods.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir declares a vow of silence after eating the Tongue of Madness mushroom.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at the group, ats the mushroom, and declares a vow of silence.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido looks at Zalthir funny after his vow of silence.
source_quote: Buppido looks at him, funny.

subject: rockfall
fact: A tremor causes rocks to fall on the group in a large cavern.
source_quote: a tremor can be felt. And then, before anyone can react, rocks fall.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is trapped under rocks after the rockfall.
source_quote: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is trapped under rocks after the rockfall.
source_quote: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is trapped under rocks after the rockfall.
source_quote: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is trapped under rocks after the rockfall.
source_quote: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is trapped under rocks after the rockfall but says he is fine.
source_quote: Grygum shouts that he’s fine

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is trapped under rocks after the rockfall.
source_quote: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is unconscious and will die if not rescued after the rockfall.
source_quote: Daz is silent. ... Zalthir examines the mage and concludes that he’s unconscious. And will die if he doesn’t get him out in time.

subject: 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The group begins their march through the Underdark on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: ## 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Faerzress
fact: The Faerzress is a surreal magic that illuminates some tunnels in the Underdark.
source_quote: the surreal magic of the *Faerzress (*Fay-YERR-zess).

subject: gray ooze
fact: The gray ooze thrashes in the water behind the escapees and then settles down.
source_quote: The grey ooze thrashes in the water behind them, extending pseudo pods into the air, and then settles down.

subject: vrock
fact: A vrock swallows Ront’s head and flies off.
source_quote: the demon... beak envelops the head and snaps it off... the creature swallows the head and then flies off.

subject: Ront's death
fact: Ront is killed by a vrock after attacking it.
source_quote: His first blow cuts through the creature's hide... the demon, with startling speed, kills him with one taloned hand

subject: Ront's body falling
fact: Ront’s headless body lands on the ground behind Daz after the vrock flies off.
source_quote: a few moments later, as he makes it to the safety of the cave, he hears the thud of the now headless body land on the ground behind him.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced as an authority who will pursue escaped prisoners.
source_quote: Ilvara will be honor bound to pursue us.

subject: Sarith's madness
fact: Sarith is overcome with bouts of madness.
source_quote: Sarith, who seems to be overcome with bouts of madness, mutters

subject: Ront's guilt
fact: Ront feels anger at his cowardice and seeks redemption by killing a vrock.
source_quote: Ront is still angry at his cowardice. He still feels that he must prove something.

subject: Grygum's protective role
fact: Grygum takes on a protective role toward Stool, recognizing him as a child seeking an adult figure.
source_quote: he could tell when a child was looking for an adult figure to protect it.

subject: Stool's telepathic ability
fact: Stool imbues his allies with telepathic powers to surprise enemies.
source_quote: Having a myconid would allow the group to surprise enemies using the telepathic powers Stool imbued his allies with.

subject: Thorin's truth-telling
fact: Thorin is compelled to tell the truth after eating the Tongue of Madness mushroom.
source_quote: *The Tongue of Madness* will compel its eater to say the truth.

subject: Zalthir's vow of silence
fact: Zalthir vows silence after eating the Tongue of Madness mushroom.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at the group, ats the mushroom, and declares a vow of silence.

subject: Buppido's faith in divine plan
fact: Buppido believes the divine plan ensures his survival to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The divine plan says I will make it Gracklstugh.
